title: Microsoft Teams Phone Direct Routing with Session Border Controller (AudioCodes) Integration
author_notes: Derived from a Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect (MSP) requirement: Session Border Controllers (AudioCodes) for Teams voice integration.

Scope: PSTN calling in Teams Phone via Direct Routing integrated with an AudioCodes SBC — pair the SBC, build the Teams voice routing stack (PSTN gateway, voice routes, PSTN usages, voice routing policies, dial plans), assign users, validate inbound/outbound + emergency. Teams side concrete; AudioCodes device specifics deferred to AudioCodes docs. White-label.
pricing: T4 (project/migration) — voice integration across Teams + SBC + carrier with cutover/validation.
